sentences.text:
This petition coming on for admission this day, th e court passed the  2 following:
 ORDER

By the instant petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner is raising grievance saying that despite acquisition of her land under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act and passing an award by the competent authority, the amount of compensation has not been paid to her.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that raising her grievance, the petitioner has made a representation (Annexure-P/5) before the Collector, District Annuppur, but neither the same has not decided nor the amount of compensation has been disbursed in the petitioner's favour.

On the other hand, learned Government Advocate has submitted that this petition can be disposed of directing the Collector, District Anuppur to decide the petitioner's pending representation or to disburse the amount of compensation in her favour.

Considering the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of directing the Collector, District Anuppur to consider and decide the petitioner's pending representation (Annexure-P/5) within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of copy of this order and pass an appropriate order thereon in accordance with law.

However, while deciding the petitioner's representation, if she is otherwise found entitled to get the amount of compensation and there is no impediment in releasing the same,
then the same be paid to petitioner.
Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the petition filed by the petitioner stands disposed of.
